acceptance_goals.construction_intent: Blade, fuller, guard, grip, and pommel remain traceable semantic parts.
acceptance_goals.focal_point_readability: The viewer reads the guard socket and central fuller before secondary wrap details.
acceptance_goals.material_storytelling: Steel, leather, and brass zones separate by role, wear, and roughness language.
acceptance_goals.ornament_intentionality: Detail follows blade centerline, guard collars, grip wrap, and pommel bevels rather than random striping.
acceptance_goals.proportion_quality: Long blade, narrow grip, broad guard, and weighted pommel keep a believable medieval weapon silhouette.
acceptance_goals.silhouette_readability: The weapon reads as a straight double-edged longsword at thumbnail distance.

required_features: brass guard and pommel material zone
edge wear and grip handling wear intent

style.theme: artist-directed medieval hero longsword with readable materials and restrained ornament
